name: ruam
description: Opens a Ruam run when you give Codex a task, with its token counts, and closes it when Codex finishes its reply. Needs Ruam added and signed in first (codex mcp add ruam --url https://mcp.ruam.ai/agent, then codex mcp login ruam).

interface.shortDescription: Logs each Codex task as a Ruam run, with its token counts.
